SELECT DISTINCT A.PRODID as id, case when A.PRODNAME is null or LENGTH(A.PRODNAME)=0 then A.PRODID else A.PRODNAME end as text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A
A.PRODID like concat_ws('','%',#{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
order by A.PRODID

SELECT DISTINCT A.INDENTIFY_MARK as id, A.INDENTIFY_MARK as text FROM chb_equ_sub A
A.INDENTIFY_MARK like concat_ws('','%',#{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
order by A.INDENTIFY_MARK
